thread:
Nina (People Ops): Quick brainstorm: we want a low-effort "Thank You Tea Cart" week for Apr 15-17 — tiny microgrants ($10) + handwritten postcard option to say thanks to teammates. keeps recognition casual and high-touch. Thoughts? :tea:
Tom (Ops): love this. tea cart could rotate bldg floors. how many carts / budget?
Leah (Eng): +1. maybe make postcards optional for remote folks — we can mail or include a virtual card.
Omar (SRE): logistics Q: if we do microgrants, how fast can finance process $10 gift cards? we should avoid payroll if possible.
Keisha (Office Admin): I can source postcards and a small tea basket for each cart. estimate: 3 carts x $40 + 200 postcards + shipping.
Nina (People Ops): ballpark budget $400. microgrants: 150 x $10 = $1500 if we do that many. maybe cap to 75 microgrants and 200 postcards. finance ok with prepaid e-gift cards coded to Events - Culture?
people-ops-bot: FYI payroll cutoff for spot awards/microgrants: Apr 14 9:00 UTC. Approvals must be submitted 24h before cutoff.
Tom (Ops): propose limit: 75 microgrants + 200 postcards + 3 tea carts. total est $1,250. approval needed from Keisha + Sasha (Finance).
Leah (Eng): can we do a short request form for managers to nominate recipients? short form -> autofill payroll tag if needed. I'll spin up a tiny Google Form.
Keisha (Office Admin): I found a vendor for postcards with a 3-day turnaround: Cardly Co. sample link: https://cardly.example/sample. Shipping to SF/NYC/LON available.
Nina (People Ops): perfect. Keisha please price and add to purchase request. Tom can you draft volunteer shifts for tea carts (30-45m slots).
Tom (Ops): will draft volunteer schedule. thinking AM (9:30-10:15) and PM (3:00-3:45) to catch both timezones.
Omar (SRE): remote folks: we should auto-send an e-gift card email + digital postcard PDF they can edit. Leah pls add an editable PDF export.
Leah (Eng): will export PDF and add as attachment in the form confirmation email.
Sasha (Finance): pinging here for approval: budget $1,250 is reasonable. pls include vendor invoices and a simple line item for microgrants. I'll need a headcount estimate by Apr 10.
Nina (People Ops): thanks Sasha. action items: Keisha get vendor invoice by Apr 9; Leah build form + PDF export; Tom publish volunteer signups; Nina to submit purchase request and payroll note for microgrants.
Keisha (Office Admin): vendor quotes incoming, will CC finance. shipping to LON may add $60.
people-ops-bot: Room booking reminder: Commons Lobby requested for Apr 15 9:00-4:00. Use /book-room to confirm.
Tom (Ops): booked Commons Lobby for Apr 15-17 9:00-4:00. screenshot in thread.
Leah (Eng): form link: https://forms.gle/tea-cart-noms — please try it and nominate a teammate. short deadline Apr 13.
Nina (People Ops): awesome. one more thought: microgrants should have simple approval: manager + People Ops signoff. keep it lightweight.
Sasha (Finance): agree. please route approvals via the form and include manager email. I'll handle coding and issuance once approvals arrive pre-cutoff.
Omar (SRE): all good from my side. excited. :raised_hands:
Nina (People Ops): thanks team. I'll post a short event blurb for #general and a separate remote thread for mailed postcards. Any blockers?
Keisha (Office Admin): none.
people-ops-bot: Event "Thank You Tea Cart" created: Apr 15-17. Expected participation: 120 onsite, 60 remote. Automated reminder scheduled for Apr 12.
